hypothesis: A strictly past-only recency-decayed item and author prior will improve cold-start and drift-sensitive ranking over the static item-popularity baseline.
change_summary: Add one deterministic recency-decayed item and author statistic, blend it with the existing smoothed item rate, and preserve the reviewed candidate interface.
expected_mechanism: Recent training interactions receive greater weight while the author prior supplies a bounded fallback for sparse or unseen videos.
success_criteria: The patch passes Gate A and the later matched-budget CPU smoke and proxy evaluations improve the primary metric without leakage or output-contract failures.
falsification_condition: Reject if Gate A fails, temporal ordering is ambiguous, the score is not finite and deterministic, or matched-budget proxy evaluation does not improve over the parent.
